newsitem.title: CROATIA: Zagreb bourse says lists repair docks Viktor Lenac.
newsitem.headline: Zagreb bourse says lists repair docks Viktor Lenac.

text.p: The Zagreb Stock Exchange said on Wednesday its listing committe had admitted Rijeka's repair docks Viktor Lenac to top stock bracket as the fourth Croatian issuer to meet its strict criteria.
Trade in 1.06 million ordinary shares in the shipyard begins on July 15, the bourse said in a news release. Its listing was sponsored by consultancy and brokerage I.C.F.
The new fully-listed stock will be referred to as VLENAC in the upper half of Reuters' ZAGSTOCK page with closing details for the Zagreb Stock Exchange.

It will be the fifth fully-listed issue alongside drugs firm Pliva, Zagrebacka Banka ordinaries and ordinary and preferred stock of Varazdinska Banka. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
